text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking past the<n>dorm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! Let's have a good<n>ol'-fashioned
barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yessiree! My folks sent over some<n>juicy steaks!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meat from the US is so succulent and<n>tender. The
juice has some real<n>flavor to it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Food like this is best served with a<n>whole bunch of
folks diggin' in.<n>That's that famous Japanese
hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So are ya down to party, Trainer?<n>Better get on
board, 'cause we're<n>blastin' off sky-high to meaty
heaven!
choice_data_list: Can't, sorry. But have a safe flight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A safe diet? You sayin' I need to take<n>care of my
health?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm, I reckon I should be watchin'what I eat. Too much meat and I mightas well be the fat on a sirloin...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll try to rein it in. I can make<n>do with just
two or three pounds of<n>steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her efforts to cut back, Taiki<n>Shuttle eats a
fair amount of meat,<n>leaving her stomach full and
her<n>vitality high.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, you better hold on tight!<n>'Cause we're
racing to see who can<n>gobble down the most steak!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry your head none<n>about eatin' too
much! They sent it in<n>bulk!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon everybody's down to dine<n>and dash
today! Or is it dine till ya<n>drop? Either way, let's eat
till our<n>bellies burst!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We end up devouring a mountain of<n>meat together.
My stomach manages<n>to remain intact, but I expect
my<n>weight to rocket upwards.
